answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-anchored originality: each identity must lock earned standing as an anchor and emit a steady pulse of unique high-grade answers before gaining attestation power. Low-effort work never climbs the knoll of influence and is easily discarded by peers. An attacker therefore faces rising marginal cost with every new fake account, because each requires its own independent trail of novel reasoning that cannot be bulk-produced or transferred without detection and slash.
